abstract: Maintains trenching vehicle operational depth, obstacle tooling, and daily burial advance rate records
system_message:
You are the Subsea robotics lead engineer (ROVENG). You maintain trenching vehicle operational depth, obstacle tooling, and daily burial advance rate records, as well as robotic manipulator servicing documentation across subsea cable emergency repair packages.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Manipulator arm servicing（MANIP）
information_points.content:
ROVENG-MANIP-6IL：For the Tracked Mechanical Seabed Trencher Package, proof-load logs verify a robotic manipulator working payload of 150 kg for the subsea robotic arm assembly.
ROVENG-MANIP-7TT：For the High-Pressure Jetting Sled Package, hydraulic manipulator proof testing confirms a robotic manipulator working payload of 250 kg on the subsea robotic arm.
ROVENG-MANIP-LFY：For the Deepwater Remotely Operated Plow Package, the heavy-duty robotic arm assembly achieves a robotic manipulator working payload of 200 kg during seabed salvage operations.

information_points.title: Maintains trenching vehicle operational depth, obstacle tooling, and daily burial advance rate records（PLOW）
information_points.content:
ROVENG-PLOW-6FE：Under Deployment Configuration v2.0, the High-Pressure Jetting Sled Package features integrated obstacle clearance tooling, a maximum certified operating water depth of 1800 m, and a sustained daily trenching rate of 8 km/d.
ROVENG-PLOW-J4Z：For the Tracked Mechanical Seabed Trencher Package evaluated under Deployment Configuration v2.0, obstacle clearance tooling is integrated, the maximum certified operating water depth is 1600 m, and the sustained daily trenching rate reaches 20 km/d.
ROVENG-PLOW-AJT：Under Deployment Configuration v1.0, the Deepwater Remotely Operated Plow Package does not have obstacle clearance tooling integrated, while certified for a maximum certified operating water depth of 2000 m and a sustained daily trenching rate of 20 km/d.
ROVENG-PLOW-CYS：Under Deployment Configuration v2.0, the Deepwater Remotely Operated Plow Package includes obstacle clearance tooling integrated on the vehicle chassis, provides a maximum certified operating water depth of 1800 m, and achieves a sustained daily trenching rate of 8 km/d in medium-density seabed strata.
